reason: A dsh plugin providing 29 educational agent skills based on MIT's Missing Semester, covering command-line use, development workflows, debugging, Git, packaging, agentic coding, collaboration, and code quality.

summaries.zh: 一个基于 MIT《Missing Semester》课程的 dsh 技能插件，提供涵盖命令行、开发工具、调试、Git、打包、智能体编程、协作与代码质量的学习指导。
summaries.en: A dsh skills plugin based on MIT's Missing Semester that provides learning guidance for command-line use, development tools, debugging, Git, packaging, agentic coding, collaboration, and code quality.

capabilities: Provides educational guidance for shell, terminal, SSH, tmux, Vim, Git, packaging, containers, debugging, profiling, testing, CI/CD, and code quality.
Provides guidance on agentic coding, context management, collaboration, code review, and technical communication.
Offers a learning workflow with exercises, review, and progress recorded in the current directory.
Installs the listed skills as a versioned dsh plugin.
